description:
IRREVERSIBLE: Start pay as you go

Moves voice and chat to pay as you go: no monthly price and no term, every minute and conversation is paid from the prepaid euro balance (top it up with `deposit_balance`). A running plan for voice or chat ends here; the minutes and conversations it still holds carry over. An account already on pay as you go stays as it is, so calling this again changes nothing. A plan renewed by card subscription is left as it is and reported as `stripe_backed`. Refused with 400 and `details.reason` `TRIAL_RUNNING` while the trial runs (the account moves over by itself when the trial ends), `NOT_DIRECT` for customers of a reseller (their reseller sets their plans) and `SIGNUP_REVIEW_PENDING` while the sign-up is still being reviewed.

confirm.description: Leave out on the first call. EchoCall then answers with a confirmation value. Ask the user for a clear yes, then repeat the call with the same arguments and this value.
